name: manual_0cbb6a
claim: A pre-commit gate that validates every staged file will reject a merge commit for content that main already holds. When merging main into a stale branch fails on OSSF-1 skill structure or memory-record id checks for files main itself contains, treat it as pre-existing main debt: list the failing files, never use --no-verify unless the operator explicitly approves that single commit, and either fix main's debt first or ask for the bypass.

decisions.notes: Merging main into the two model-governance branches was blocked in both repositories by gates that check main's own already-merged files (an oversized canonical SKILL.md in orama-system, a graduated lesson whose id is not derived from its claim in Perpetua-Tools).
